name: OKC_CONTRACT_TYPES_B
description: This entity has the Contract Type Setup information.

columns.name: SET_ID
columns.description: Identifies a set of reference data shared across business units and other entities. Also known as Reference Data Sets, they are used to filter reference data in transactional UIs.

columns.name: START_DATE
columns.description: The beginning of the active period, one second after midnight on the date indicated.

columns.name: END_DATE
columns.description: The end of the active period, one second before midnight on the date indicated.

columns.name: ALLOW_LINES_FLAG
columns.description: Flag to indicate if lines are allowed on Contract Type

columns.name: ALLOW_EXTERNAL_ITEM_FLAG
columns.description: Flag to indicate if external item master is allowed on contract lines using the current contract type.

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: ITEM_SOURCE_CODE
columns.description: Lookup Code for Item Source: PIM, CRM or EXT

columns.name: CHR_TYPE
columns.description: Unique user defined contract type code that can be used as attribute_category in contract header DFF

columns.name: LINE_CLASS
columns.description: Indicates if the Sell Intent Contract Type with Enterprise Contract Class has SERVICE or PROJECT Lines.

columns.name: PRICING_SYSTEM_CODE
columns.description: For Sales Agreement with the contract type class as 'Agreement', intent as 'Sell', allow lines as 'Y', Pricing system can be Fusion SCM Pricer or Fusion Sales Cloud Price Book.

columns.name: PRICE_DURING_BILLING_YN
columns.description: Flag to check if price will be determined during billing

columns.name: CONTRACT_MODIFIER_FLAG
columns.description: Flag to indicate if contract modifier is allowed on contract

columns.name: AMEND_NO_VERSION_FLAG
columns.description: Flag to indicate if contract needs to be versioned during amendment.

columns.name: ESIGN_TEMPLATE_FLAG
columns.description: Flag to indicate the usage of esignature template.

columns.name: ENABLE_TXN_ADJ_ON_AMEND
columns.description: When the option is enabled, the applicable billing transactions are marked for adjustment on the approval of the project contract amendment based on the amendment effective date provided. If the option is disabled, billing transactions are not marked for adjustment on the approval of the project contract amendment, irrespective of the amendment effective date provided. Valid values are Y or N.

columns.name: COPY_AMEND_DOC_FLAG
columns.description: This flag indicates to copy contract documents during amendment versioning; Possible values Y/N. Default is Y.

columns.name: CONT_AI_SUMMARY_GENERATE_FLAG
columns.description: Flag to decide whether Ai summary will be generated for Contract with this Contract Type.

columns.name: AI_SUMMARY_AGENT_TEAM_CODE
columns.description: Agent team code which is used to invoke the summary agent.

columns.name: BILL_GROUP_REQD_FLAG
columns.description: Flag which indicates whether the BILL_GROUP column must be populated in the PJB_BILL_TRXS table for transactions to be added to invoices. A value of 'Y' indicates that the BILL_GROUP column must be populated, while values of 'N' or null allow any transactions to be invoiced, irrespective of whether BILL_GROUP is populated.

columns.name: AI_ADVISOR_AGENT_FLAG
columns.description: Flag to toggle Advisor Agent via Smart Action and process documents for Contract with this Contract Type.
